tex_content.label: 2Dsoliton
tex_content.html:
The only oriented two-dimensional $\kappa $-solution is the shrinking round $2$-sphere.
Proof

↗ prop:kl-asymptotic-solitons-existence-ricci-solitons \sketch The only nonflat oriented nonnegatively curved two-dimensional gradient shrinking soliton is the round sphere; the noncompact case is excluded using Proposition 6.1, as in \cite{Ye2}. The asymptotic rescalings and Hamilton’s surface pinching argument \cite{Hamsurface} then make every slice round.

□
